name: Vibe RAG
description: Retrieves relevant excerpts from a full corpus file and injects them into prompt context.

sourcePath.label: Corpus File
sourcePath.help: Workspace-relative path to the full corpus text file.

topK.label: Top K Documents
topK.help: Maximum number of retrieved corpus documents to consider per turn.

maxSnippetChars.label: Max Snippet Chars
maxSnippetChars.help: Per-document snippet size injected into prompt context.

maxTotalChars.label: Max Total Chars
maxTotalChars.help: Maximum total retrieval context injected per turn.

fallbackDocs.label: Fallback Docs
fallbackDocs.help: How many style-only fallback excerpts to inject when the query is weak.

heartbeatDocs.label: Heartbeat Docs
heartbeatDocs.help: How many excerpts to inject for heartbeat/proactive runs.

recentBias.label: Recent Bias
recentBias.help: Light score bonus for newer documents.

aggressionBias.label: Aggression Bias
aggressionBias.help: Adds more weight to compact, harder-edged excerpts during ranking.

poisonPoolSize.label: Poison Pool Size
poisonPoolSize.help: How much of the spiciest corpus is available for style carry and heartbeat.

heartbeatPoisonBias.label: Heartbeat Poison Bias
heartbeatPoisonBias.help: Extra poison weighting when the trigger is heartbeat.
